time_policy: Explicit engine operations and meaningful fictional actions advance simulation time; chat messages, reloads, and real-world absence do not.
randomness_policy: One persisted result per authorized attempt or process run; retries recover the result.
will_policy: Will preparation pins exact contracts, inputs, judgments, and one random result; only unchanged engine-owned preparation may commit a will_attempt event.
judgment_policy: The host supplies bounded semantic judgments and narration; unsupported mechanics remain pending or proposed.
visibility_policy: World state, observations, beliefs, and institutional records are separate; viewer context filters hidden values.
personality_policy: Exact-version authored approach weights use existing character/relationship/Will context. They never become action-success modifiers or mandatory choices. Dialogue annotations and consequences remain semantically reviewed by the GM.
writing_policy: Session exposes versioned writing guidance; scoped briefs and reviewed delivery use existing state. Semantic prose review remains host responsibility.
